machine: Mac mini (Mac18,5), Apple M6 (2 super, 4 performance, 6 efficiency cores, 12-core GPU), 16 GB, macOS 27.2
baseline: whisper.cpp Metal, greedy (beam 1), flash attention, 8 threads, Silero VAD v5.1.2 with sayit's VAD tuning, AUDIO_CTX_ADAPTIVE=1
method: Warm whisper-servers side by side, every clip sent to every arm in rotating order through bin/sayit-transcribe (no .env, no wordlist, empty prompt); wall time of sayit-transcribe. Errors are word-level edit distance against FLEURS' normalised transcription (strict), words on non-speech clips count as errors.

sets.fl341: FLEURS sv_se test, every distinct sentence, first recording each (4.2-31.5 s)
sets.long: 12 concatenations of consecutive fl341 clips, 15-30 s
sets.short: 100 cuts of 1.1-3.5 s at real pauses; the reference split is checked on both sides of the cut
sets.nonspeech: 44 clips of 1.5-2.3 s joined from FLEURS' quiet lead-ins and tails, 2 s of digital silence and three of faint white noise
sets.noisy-white: the first 100 fl341 clips under white noise at 5 dB SNR
sets.noisy-babble: the 100 short cuts over three other FLEURS speakers at 10 dB SNR
